  GROUP BY

  FROM (
    SELECT

    WHERE

  ) AS orders
  LEFT JOIN (

      __slayer_q.tier AS tier
    FROM (
      SELECT

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY customers.id
          ORDER BY CASE WHEN customers.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, customers.id
        ) AS __slayer_r
      FROM customers AS customers
    ) AS __slayer_q
    WHERE
      __slayer_q.__slayer_r = 1
  ) AS customers

  WHERE

  GROUP BY
    DATETRUNC(month, orders.created_at)

  _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum.[m]
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum
  ON (
    (
      _base.[orders___created_at] = _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum.[created_at]
      AND NOT _base.[orders___created_at] IS NULL
      AND NOT _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum.[created_at] IS NULL
    )
    OR (
